issue: The service already supplies payment_id as the gateway idempotency key on every call; only the one-attempt retry ceiling prevents recovery from a documented pre-debit timeout.
public_check: Tests pre- and post-debit timeouts, repeated payment ID, distinct IDs and permanent errors.
decision: The missing retry count is known and the public checks cover the consequential duplicate-debit boundary; no separate Controller investigation has an unresolved premise.

issue: A caller requests replay safety but does not specify which field denotes one logical payment or whether duplicate requests with changed amounts must be rejected.
public_check: Only ordinary debit success is shown; no authoritative logical-payment identity is supplied.
decision: Ask the caller to define the durable payment identity and changed-amount policy before changing retry or idempotency behaviour.
